summary: The city has rented this neighbourhood's public library on Leland Avenue since 1935 — first a shop at number 37, later number 45, and for decades from the same landlord, Mary L. Baumann. In 1940 it handed land at Sunnydale Avenue to the Housing Authority, and it is still rebuilding what went up there. The community centre on Raymond Avenue has been asking the Board for money since 1937 and closing its street for a fair ever since. In 1961 the Board refused to let the neighbourhood's bus line be cut.
